tool.name: Render Widget
tool.description: Render an existing saved widget by slug in the conversation UI by emitting a ui_action (render_widget). Looks up the widget for the current STARSHIP_ID and renders it.

slug.description: Widget slug to render (within current starship)

nodes.name: Emit render_widget
